entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-08
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • EnumToStringConverter still silently converts empty string to the default enum value #39182
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: GetStream reads another row, or throws, when the INTEGER primary key is not the rowid #39139
    12.0-preview1
  • Sum throwing exception when property has a ValueConverter with ConvertsNulls set to true #30233
    12.0-preview1
  • `Sqlite:Autoincrement` is not generated for key column when the entity has owned property #34608
  • Unnecessary `IS NOT NULL` filter on unique indexes for TPT tables on SQL Server #32689
    12.0-preview1
  • scaffold vs Sql Server [Embedding] [vector](1536, float32) #38763
    12.0-preview1
  • AlterColumnOperation.OldColumn is missing some details #28041
  • Migrations: Complex property order incorrect in CreateTable #31259
    12.0-preview1
  • SQL truncated at lines starting with "go" in migrationBuilder.Sql #34183
    12.0-preview1
  • NullReferenceException when configuring ToJson() twice #32513
    12.0-preview1
  • "Foreign keys are both mapped to <Table> but referencing different principal tables" on long entity names #28488
    12.0-preview1

Updated

  • FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning is not logged for First/FirstOrDefault on a collection navigation in a subquery #39129
    Backlog
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #39192
    8.0.x
  • ExecuteDelete reports CommandSource.ExecuteUpdate to interceptors and diagnostics #39186
    10.0.15
  • Add a bulk configuration API for JsonValueReaderWriter #31316
    Backlog
  • Create fluent API for JsonValueReaderWriter on a property #31647
    Backlog
  • Cosmos DB: DateTime serialization format causing errors in ordering and filtering #39113
    Backlog
  • Seeded geometry is re-updated when scaffolding new migration [NetTopologySuite] #27374
    Backlog
  • Precompiled query throws InvalidCastException materializing a property whose value converter is a ValueConverter subclass #39174
  • Allow changing CLR type in query translation without additional SQL #33733
    Backlog
  • ToString() on an enum with a string value converter fails in projections on EF 11 ("No coercion operator is defined"), possible regression from #38156 #39146
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Add Array.IndexOf translation for byte arrays in SQL Server and SQLite #39203
    community-contribution
  • Fix constant guid select #39200
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Report CommandSource.ExecuteDelete for ExecuteDelete commands #39199
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0] Report CommandSource.ExecuteDelete for ExecuteDelete commands #39197
    Servicing-consider

Merged

  • Merge code coverage reports across AzDO jobs #39175
  • Reduce the amount of concurrency in Deadlock_on_inserts_and_deletes_with_dependents_is_handled_correctly to a avoid sporadic timeout on LocalDB #39180
  • Update Vally MCP SDK dependency #39196
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39204
  • Read the row's data in GetStream when the INTEGER primary key is not the rowid #39202
    community-contribution
  • Fix and extend single-result subquery lifting #39107
    community-contribution, api-review
  • Don't add an IS NOT NULL filter to unique indexes on required TPT and TPC columns on SQL Server #39161
    community-contribution
  • Type the zero in COALESCE(SUM(...), 0) to match the SUM result #39160
    community-contribution
  • Improve skills and evals #39177
    area-harness
  • Preserve relational query cancellation tokens when enumeration supplies none #39201
  • Place complex property columns in CLR property order when creating tables #39163
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Add regression tests for three issues already fixed #39165
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Preserve SQLITE_DETERMINISTIC when re-registering functions on Open #39159
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Report CommandSource.ExecuteDelete for ExecuteDelete commands #39187
    community-contribution
  • Read vector dimensions when scaffolding SQL Server databases below compatibility level 170 #39162
    community-contribution

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39194
  • Implement SQLite ADO.NET schema collections #39188
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #39193
  • Cosmos datetime fixed width #39131
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Preserve value-converter cast when simplifying projections #39195
    Servicing-consider
  • Clarify that Include requires navigation property access (#33018) #39189
    community-contribution
